data.rationale: The first four steps match the true workflow in order (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number), but the proposal adds a city parameter and a "Find my bus" click that the true workflow doesn't show. An automation built from it would have to guess the city value, so it is only partly runnable.
